finding: F6C-15; reviews/F2-06-C-capacity-reliability-changeability-alternatives.md; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9 adverse row 11, benign column
case: A supersession with an empty closure, which must reopen nothing and must pass.
why: The benign row of section 9 is a supersession that found nothing to reopen, and the `present`-rather-than-`nonempty` choice in the original pin is deliberate and correct for it: an absent closure and an empty one are different facts. An empty closure has no accepted members, so the corrected containment is vacuously satisfied and the record passes -- which is what keeps this repair from turning a walk that legitimately found nothing into a failure. The patch restates the walk-completed flag as its own presence check, a hardening in the same shape.
